method.name: markNotDeliveredIfHead
method.purpose: marks the head message not-delivered (its window is closed) in one transaction, only if it is still the head and still queued or retrying; false otherwise

rationale: S003 added it to the store: a message whose window closed must leave the queue head so the queue moves on, and it must be one guarded transaction. Built and approved in S003; the HLD sketch did not name it.
